title: Raised stem stitch wheel
subtitle: Stem stitch worked in concentric rings over a spoke foundation for a dimensional circle
excerpt: A raised stem stitch wheel builds a dimensional circular motif by working rows of stem stitch around a spoke framework, filling outward from the centre to produce a raised padded disc.
sourceNotes: Contemporary stumpwork and surface embroidery practice. Builds on the raised stem-stitch band technique and the woven wheel framework.

glossaryTerms.definition: The set of straight stitches radiating from the centre of a circular motif, over which the working thread is woven or stitched to build the surface.

heroPrompt: Raised stem stitch wheel on white cotton, a dimensional padded disc in deep red thread, the spoke lines barely visible beneath, close-up, natural light.

content.text: A raised stem stitch wheel lays a

framework and then works stem stitch in concentric circles around the spokes, with the needle passing over one spoke and under the next on each pass. As the rows fill outward the surface rises and pads, producing a dimensional disc that stands slightly proud of the fabric.

items.label: Thread
items.value: Stranded cotton, 2 strands; a heavier thread such as perle no. 8 builds height faster

content.text: Lay an odd number of spokes (5 or 7) meeting at the centre.
Bring the needle up close to the centre. Weave it over one spoke, under the next, keeping the thread on the surface.
Work around the circle, passing over and under alternating spokes. The thread does not enter the fabric on this step.
Continue outward until the spokes are covered to the desired radius. Finish by inserting the needle into the fabric.

items.symptom: The centre has a visible hole
items.cause: Starting the first ring too far from the centre.
items.fix: Begin the first pass as close to the spoke intersection as possible.

items.symptom: The wheel tilts to one side
items.cause: Pulling the working thread tighter in one direction.
items.fix: Keep consistent tension on every pass and check the wheel is even from above as you work.

content.text: Raised stem stitch wheels appear as flower heads, berries, and coin shapes in stumpwork and contemporary dimensional embroidery. Different colours on each ring produce a striped or gradient disc.
